name: add_k8s_service_selector_port_mapping
description: Authors a ClusterIP Service that correctly selects an existing Deployment's pods and maps to its real container port
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml (already present, do not modify it) runs the 'catalog' Deployment, whose pods are labeled app: catalog and whose container listens on port 9090 (NOT 80). Create k8s/service.yaml defining a ClusterIP Service named 'catalog-service' that selects those pods (selector app: catalog) and exposes port 80 externally, forwarding to the container's REAL port 9090 via targetPort. Do not assume port and targetPort are the same number - use the container's actual port.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalog
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalog
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalog
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: catalog
          image: myorg/catalog:1.4.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 9090

test_setup_files.test_service.py:
import yaml

with open('k8s/service.yaml') as f:
    svc = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert svc.get('kind') == 'Service', svc.get('kind')
assert svc.get('metadata', {}).get('name') == 'catalog-service'

spec = svc['spec']
assert spec.get('type', 'ClusterIP') == 'ClusterIP', f"expected ClusterIP, got {spec.get('type')!r}"
assert spec.get('selector') == {'app': 'catalog'}, f"selector must be exactly {{app: catalog}}, got {spec.get('selector')!r}"

ports = spec.get('ports')
assert ports and len(ports) >= 1
p0 = ports[0]
assert p0.get('port') == 80, f"port must be 80, got {p0.get('port')!r}"
assert p0.get('targetPort') == 9090, f"targetPort must be the container's real port 9090, got {p0.get('targetPort')!r}"

# deployment untouched
with open('k8s/deployment.yaml') as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)
assert dep['spec']['replicas'] == 3, 'deployment.yaml was modified'
container_port = dep['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['ports'][0]['containerPort']
assert container_port == 9090, 'deployment.yaml was modified'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.k8s/service.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalog-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: catalog
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 9090
